name: selection
description: File-level selection across a history of real commits, checked two ways: against a Quint model of import, conftest, declaration, content-read, package-initializer and command-line-plugin closure, and against pytest itself, which must never load a changed file in a test the planner skipped.

actions.init: create a fixture repository and commit it
actions.edit: rewrite one file's body, commit, then select
actions.link: add an import to one file (import pkg.x, import tests.helpers, from pkg import *, or a bare import helpers), commit, then select
actions.unlink: remove an import from one file, commit, then select
actions.remove: delete a file, commit, then select
actions.restore: add a deleted file back without imports or declarations, commit, then select
actions.declare: add a # gv:test-dependency: comment to a test, commit, then select
actions.undeclare: remove a # gv:test-dependency: comment, commit, then select
actions.breakSyntax: make a Python file unparseable, commit, then select
actions.repair: make an unparseable file parse again, commit, then select
actions.touchGlobal: edit requirements.txt, a default global input, commit, then select
actions.toggleConfig: flip test_roots between tests and tests/sub, or add/remove data/table.json as a global input, then plan the last commit again
actions.restart: close the graph cache (it prunes on close), reopen it, then plan the last commit again
actions.corrupt: empty every stored graph's edges without updating its checksum, then plan the last commit again
actions.inspect: read the last selections without committing

mutants.name: head-edges-only
mutants.description: Plans with the head tree's edges only, so a deleted module's former importers are not selected.

mutants.name: direct-importers-only
mutants.description: Follows only files that import a changed file directly, not their importers.

mutants.name: global-inputs-ignored
mutants.description: Treats requirements.txt like any unreferenced file instead of selecting every test.

mutants.name: content-follows-imports
mutants.description: Reads a kind: content declaration as an import, so it also follows the read file's imports.

mutants.name: conftest-scope-collapsed
mutants.description: Scopes every conftest to the top test directory, so tests/sub/conftest.py reaches every test.

mutants.name: parse-errors-ignored
mutants.description: Treats an unparseable file as importing nothing instead of stopping with an error.

mutants.name: assumes-consecutive-base
mutants.description: Plans every run against the head it planned last, which is right only between neighbouring commits.

mutants.name: cache-key-omits-test-roots
mutants.description: Leaves test_roots out of the cached graph's key, so a graph built for the old roots is reused after they change.

mutants.name: parse-cache-keyed-by-path
mutants.description: Caches parsed files by path instead of content, so an edited file keeps its old imports.

mutants.name: cache-checksum-ignored
mutants.description: Trusts a stored graph without checking its checksum, so a damaged entry is used as if it were valid.

mutants.name: star-exports-ignored
mutants.description: Reintroduces the star-import bug: from pkg import * no longer reaches the submodules pkg lists in __all__.

mutants.name: addopts-plugins-ignored
mutants.description: Reintroduces the plugin bug: a plugin named by -p in addopts is no longer a dependency of every test.

mutants.name: prepend-roots-ignored
mutants.description: Reintroduces the import-mode bug: imports no longer resolve from the directories pytest prepends to sys.path.

limits: One repository: three modules and their package initializer (with __all__), a test-root helper, a command-line plugin loaded by addopts -p, a root and a nested conftest, three tests, one data file and one content-kind sidecar; at most 8 operations per sampled history.

Import spellings are import pkg.x, import tests.helpers, from pkg import * and a prepend-mode bare import helpers. Other forms (relative and dynamic imports, module strings, undeclared file reads, symlinks) are not generated.

The runtime check records imports and opened files during pytest's collection of each test file, with plugin autoloading off and the default prepend import mode. It is a lower bound: a test that loads a changed file must be selected, but selecting more is not a failure. It is skipped for mutant cases, which the model comparison judges.

First-party pins, name-scoped modules, deferred strings and Django URLconf policy are outside the model. The graph cache is exercised through configuration edits, restarts and damaged entries; only answers are compared.
Each step is a real Git commit or a re-plan of the last one, selected by affected() through one GraphCache per history; the driver's mapping of paths to file names is trusted.

bugs_found.summary: A test that does `from pkg import *` was not selected when a submodule pkg lists in __all__ changed.
bugs_found.found_by: the runtime check (pytest loaded the changed file, the planner skipped the test), after an adversarial review reported it; witness starImportFollowsAllTest

bugs_found.summary: Editing a plugin loaded by `addopts = -p NAME` selected no test, though it is loaded into every session.
bugs_found.found_by: the runtime check (pytest loaded the changed file, the planner skipped the test), after an adversarial review reported it; witness commandLinePluginSelectsEveryTestTest and random histories

bugs_found.summary: A bare `import helpers` resolved by pytest's default import mode was not followed, so editing tests/helpers.py selected nothing.
bugs_found.found_by: the runtime check (pytest loaded the changed file, the planner skipped the test), after an adversarial review reported it; witness bareTestImportFollowsPrependModeTest
